author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I feel like I am expert astrologer, numerologist, tarot reader, feng shi master and philosopher.

Generative AI is the ultimate BS machine, if there is no way to judge the correctness of an answer, GenAI can hallucinate way better than human.

Don't use AI to replace experts, use AI to replace BS-ers

reshared_post.author_headline: AI advisor to founders and executives · OpenAI private beta tester (2021) · Lisbon & SF
reshared_post.reshared_text:
The most dangerous sentence in tech right now?

“Generative AI is amazing at tasks where I’m not qualified to judge the output.”

If I ask ChatGPT to write Python code, and I don't know Python, I’m impressed because it looks like code. It runs (mostly). It solves the immediate problem.

But I have no idea if it’s secure, scalable, or hallucinated garbage.

We are currently seeing a massive surge in the "Illusion of Competence."

We feel like designers.
We feel like lawyers.
We feel like developers.

But without the domain expertise to critique the output, we aren't creators - we are just gambling that the machine is right.

Don't use AI to replace the expert. Use AI to accelerate the expert.
